name: Shako VM
description: A new Shako VM for this workspace, deleted with it. A copy of your VM orca-base when you have one (its agents stay logged in), else a small VM with Claude Code and Codex. It sleeps when idle.
create:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
if ! shako vm info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if shako vm info orca-base >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    shako vm cp orca-base "$name" >&2 || exit 1
  else
    shako vm create "$name" --agent claude,codex >&2 || exit 1
  fi
fi
shako vm wake "$name" >&2 || exit 1
host=$(shako vm info "$name" | awk '$1 == "ssh" { print $2; exit }')
[ -n "$host" ] || { echo "shako: no SSH name for $name" >&2; exit 1; }
root="/home/shako/$(printf %s "$(basename "${ORCA_REPO_PATH:-project}")" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '-')"
ref="${ORCA_REPO_REF:-$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo main)}"
head="${ORCA_REPO_REF_HEAD:-$(git rev-parse --verify "$ref^{commit}")}" || exit 1
case "$ref" in
  refs/heads/*) branch="${ref#refs/heads/}"; refs="+$head:$ref" ;;
  refs/remotes/*) rest="${ref#refs/remotes/}"; branch="${rest#*/}"; refs="+$head:refs/heads/$branch +$head:$ref" ;;
  */*) branch="${ref#*/}"; refs="+$head:refs/heads/$branch +$head:refs/remotes/$ref" ;;
  *) branch="$ref"; refs="+$head:refs/heads/$branch" ;;
esac
ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$host" "git init -q '$root' && git -C '$root' config receive.denyCurrentBranch updateInstead" >&2 || exit 1
git -c core.sshCommand="ssh -o BatchMode=yes" push -q --no-verify "ssh://$host$root" $refs >&2 || exit 1
ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$host" "git -C '$root' checkout -q -f -B '$branch' '$head'" >&2 || exit 1
if [ -n "$ORCA_REPO_URL" ]; then
  ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$host" "git -C '$root' remote add origin '$ORCA_REPO_URL' 2>/dev/null || git -C '$root' remote set-url origin '$ORCA_REPO_URL'" >&2
fi
printf '{"schemaVersion":1,"connection":{"type":"ssh","projectRoot":"%s","target":{"label":"%s","host":"%s","port":22,"username":"shako"}},"userData":{"provider":"shako","vm":"%s"}}\n' "$root" "$name" "$host" "$name"
suspend:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
shako vm sleep "$name" >&2 || ! shako vm info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1
resume:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
shako vm wake "$name" >&2 || exit 1
host=$(shako vm info "$name" | awk '$1 == "ssh" { print $2; exit }')
[ -n "$host" ] || { echo "shako: no SSH name for $name" >&2; exit 1; }
root="/home/shako/$(printf %s "$(basename "${ORCA_REPO_PATH:-project}")" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '-')"
printf '{"schemaVersion":1,"connection":{"type":"ssh","projectRoot":"%s","target":{"label":"%s","host":"%s","port":22,"username":"shako"}},"userData":{"provider":"shako","vm":"%s"}}\n' "$root" "$name" "$host" "$name"
destroy:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
shako vm rm "$name" --yes >&2 || ! shako vm info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1
